description: This file defines the Dependent class, which extends ListableDisplayField, and specifies its DTO class, entity aliases, and fields relevant to displaying dependent information within the reporting system of the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: Represents a display field for dependents in the report module, inheriting from ListableDisplayField and providing specific configurations for dependent data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, specifically for dependents.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides entity alias mappings used in database queries for dependent records.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields related to employee dependents that this display field will use.
